content.short: Origami is an automated leverage protocol that packages looped yield strategies into single tokens.
content.description: Origami automates leverage: it takes yield strategies that would otherwise require repeated borrowing and redepositing, and wraps them into a single position the protocol manages. It launched on Ethereum and has deployed on Plasma. Automating the loop removes the manual work and some of the liquidation-monitoring burden, though the underlying leverage risk remains.
content.meta: Origami is an automated leverage protocol packaging looped yield strategies, on Ethereum and Plasma.
